FX-CIRCLE-001.says: The settings as they start: centre in the middle, radius 75, edge none, white, opacity 100, blending mode none: the disk covers the whole small frame, white everywhere, the cel gone.

FX-CIRCLE-002.says: Radius 4: a white disk 8 across at (8, 5), the pixels on its rim partly covered, the rest clear.

FX-CIRCLE-003.says: Radius 4, outer feather 4: the rim ramps over 4 pixels, from 2 inside to 2 outside.

FX-CIRCLE-004.says: Edge Radius, radius 4, edge radius 2: a ring from 2 to 4.

FX-CIRCLE-005.says: Edge Radius, radius 2, edge radius 4: the same ring, the larger of the two outside.

FX-CIRCLE-006.says: Thickness 2, radius 4: the ring inside the radius, from 2 to 4, FX-CIRCLE-004's.

FX-CIRCLE-007.says: Thickness * Radius, thickness 50, radius 4: thickness 50 per cent of the radius, 2, FX-CIRCLE-006's.

FX-CIRCLE-008.says: Thickness & Feather * Radius, thickness 50, outer feather 50, inner feather 25, radius 4: thickness 2, feathers 2 and 1, as Thickness with those.

FX-CIRCLE-009.says: Thickness 2, radius 4, inner feather 2: the inner edge soft, the outer sharp.

FX-CIRCLE-010.says: Thickness 10, radius 4: thicker than the radius, a whole disk, FX-CIRCLE-002's.

FX-CIRCLE-011.says: Radius 4, Invert Circle on: white everywhere but the disk, clear in it.

FX-CIRCLE-012.says: Radius 4, orange #ff8000 at opacity 50: an orange disk at half covering.

FX-CIRCLE-013.says: Radius 4, normal: a white disk over the cel, the cel round it.

FX-CIRCLE-014.says: Radius 4, violet #6450a0, multiply: the cel darkened in the disk.

FX-CIRCLE-015.says: Radius 4, violet, screen: the cel lightened in the disk.

FX-CIRCLE-019.says: Radius 4, stencil alpha: the cel seen only through the disk.

FX-CIRCLE-020.says: Radius 4, normal at opacity 0: the cel exactly as it was.

FX-CIRCLE-021.says: Radius keyed from 2 at frame 0 to 6 at frame 4, linear: the disk grows; frame 2 is radius 4.

FX-CIRCLE-022.says: Radius 3, the centre keyed from (50, 50) at frame 0 to (25, 50) at frame 4, linear: the disk slides left, 1 pixel a frame.

FX-CIRCLE-023.says: FX-CIRCLE-013 moved three pixels right: the disk moves with the layer.

FX-CIRCLE-024.says: After a Motion Tile that grows the layer: the centre is the drawing's own, so the frame is FX-CIRCLE-002's.

FX-CIRCLE-025.says: FX-CIRCLE-012 with its colour in capitals, #FF8000: the same.

FX-CIRCLE-026.says: Radius 10, the centre at (-25, 50) per cent, outside the drawing: the left edge of the frame covered, the right clear.

FX-CIRCLE-027.says: Edge none with an inner feather of 3: the inner feather is not used, FX-CIRCLE-002's.

FX-CIRCLE-028.says: Opacity keyed from 100 at frame 0 to 0 at frame 4 past its end by an ease, radius 4: held at 0, frame 4 clear everywhere.

FX-CIRCLE-029.says: Radius 0, edge none: nothing covered, clear everywhere.

FX-CIRCLE-030.says: Radius -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CIRCLE-031.says: Radius 10001, above 10000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CIRCLE-032.says: Edge "ring", not one of its five words. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CIRCLE-033.says: Edge thickness -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CIRCLE-034.says: Outer feather 10001, above 10000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CIRCLE-035.says: Opacity 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CIRCLE-036.says: Centre 1001 per cent across, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CIRCLE-037.says: Invert "yes", not off or on. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CIRCLE-038.says: Blending mode "darken", which this program does not have. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CIRCLE-039.says: Colour "#12345", not six hex digits. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CIRCLE-040.says: Radius keyed to 10001 at frame 4, above 10000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
